title: Vispectra: A compiler for spectroscopic file formats
description:
Vispectra is a cross-platform, browser-based spectra plotter. At its core, it is a compiler that infers the grammar of spectroscopic files (UV-Vis, XRD, XPS, Raman, IR) from a sample of their data, builds a structural contract (the *canon*), and applies it to the rest. This approach addresses the problem of reading messy, heterogeneous instrument files and relates to the positive-only grammatical inference problem (Gold, 1967).

This version (v0.1.0-alpha) includes the complete parser specification, the documented pipeline architecture, and phases 00 (reading) and 09 (diagnostics) implemented. The compiler does not yet parse files: phases 01–08 are under development.
